 class UnitNormItemEmbedding(nn.Embedding):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.radius_logits = nn.Parameter(self.weight.new_zeros((self.num_embeddings, 1)))
+
     def forward(self, indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         embeddings = super().forward(indices)
         embeddings = torch.nn.functional.normalize(embeddings, p=2, dim=-1, eps=1e-12)
+        logits = torch.nn.functional.embedding(indices, self.radius_logits, padding_idx=0)
+        radii = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.tanh(logits)
+        embeddings = embeddings * radii
         return embeddings.masked_fill(indices.eq(0).unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
